skills.name: ask-liyuk
skills.short_description: 根据问题选择方法和必要顺序
skills.core_judgment: 先识别要作的决定或交付物，只走当前需要的路径
skills.when_to_use: 不确定该从哪个方法开始，或任务横跨多个方法
skills.input_example: 失败项目怎样写进自评？
skills.result_example: 说明先形成学习、检查经历或直接组织表达的适用路径。
skills.boundary: 入口做导航；具体判断由相应技能完成。
skills.boundary_en: The entry point routes; the matching skill makes the specific judgment.
skills.core_judgment_en: Identify the decision or deliverable, then follow only the path needed now.

skills.name: tech-planning
skills.short_description: 选择技术投入、优先级与重审信号
skills.core_judgment: 技术动作必须对应业务结果与能力缺口，并比较继续现状等选择
skills.when_to_use: 形成未来投入、路线图或比较工程投资
skills.input_example: 资源只够做两项，如何选择本季投入？
skills.result_example: 给出可比较选择、约束和检查点，未知容量不编排期。
skills.boundary: 已有方案够不够支持决定，用tech-review。
skills.boundary_en: To judge whether an existing proposal can support a decision, use tech-review.
skills.core_judgment_en: Tie technical work to business outcomes and capability gaps; compare it with keeping the status quo.

skills.name: tech-review
skills.short_description: 审查已有方案的证据与交付准备
skills.core_judgment: 只报告有依据且会影响决定的问题，足够好可以通过
skills.when_to_use: 已有架构、迁移、试点或采纳方案需要评审
skills.input_example: 这份灰度方案有测试却没有停止条件，能上线吗？
skills.result_example: 结论与有原文依据的风险、影响和补充动作。
skills.boundary: 从空白选择投资用tech-planning，数字本身的可信度用metric-decision。
skills.boundary_en: To choose an investment from a blank slate, use tech-planning. To judge whether a number itself is trustworthy, use metric-decision.
skills.core_judgment_en: Report only evidence-backed issues that affect the decision; pass proposals that are good enough.

skills.name: metric-decision
skills.short_description: 先核对测量，再判断变化与行动
skills.core_judgment: 口径与可比性未确认前，指标变化不能直接充当成果或因果证据
skills.when_to_use: 定义指标，解释变化或判断数字支持什么行动
skills.input_example: SDK迁移同周成功率下降，是否立刻重构？
skills.result_example: 区分测量变化与系统变化，提出能区分解释的验证。
skills.boundary: 它核对数字证据；较广方案审查用tech-review。症状还没形成可检验的问题用problem-location。
skills.boundary_en: It checks numeric evidence. For a broader proposal review, use tech-review. When symptoms are not yet an inspectable problem, use problem-location.
skills.core_judgment_en: Until definitions and comparability are confirmed, metric changes are not outcome or causal evidence.

skills.name: management-retro
skills.short_description: 还原完成的工作，选择下一次改进
skills.core_judgment: 分清事实、解释与下一轮动作，不把事后解释写成根因
skills.when_to_use: 完成的项目、周期或事故需要形成学习
skills.input_example: 项目延期后，哪些机制值得改变？
skills.result_example: 还原关键决定，比较解释，提出可检查的改进。
skills.boundary: 已有结论的表达用eng-reporting。症状或指责还没形成可检验的问题时先用problem-location。
skills.boundary_en: To express a conclusion that is already formed, use eng-reporting. When symptoms or blame are not yet an inspectable problem, use problem-location first.
skills.core_judgment_en: Separate facts, explanations, and next actions; do not treat hindsight as root cause.

skills.name: eng-reporting
skills.short_description: 把已有判断写成读者可决策的材料
skills.core_judgment: 先确定读者要作的决定，表达不能强化未知或补造收益
skills.when_to_use: 整理纪要、已有结论、成果和自评材料
skills.input_example: 把已确认的试点结论整理成管理摘要。
skills.result_example: 保留证据状态，清楚说明待决事项与所需支持。
skills.boundary: 经历是否有证据用experience-review，原因未形成用management-retro。
skills.boundary_en: To check whether an experience claim is evidenced, use experience-review. When the cause is not yet formed, use management-retro.
skills.core_judgment_en: Identify the reader’s decision first; do not strengthen uncertain claims or invent benefits.

skills.name: experience-review
skills.short_description: 检查个人贡献、判断、结果与证据
skills.core_judgment: 团队结果与个人贡献分开，材料缺口不等于没有能力
skills.when_to_use: 已有面试、晋升或自查经历需要审阅
skills.input_example: 团队CTR涨18%，我负责接口，这样写个人贡献准确吗？
skills.result_example: 指出主张支持范围和关键追问，仅review时不重写。
skills.boundary: eng-reporting组织表达，本技能检查经历与证据。面试官评估候选人用hiring-assessment。
skills.boundary_en: eng-reporting organizes the wording; this skill checks the experience and its evidence. Interviewers assessing a candidate use hiring-assessment.
skills.core_judgment_en: Separate team outcomes from personal contribution; missing evidence does not prove a lack of ability.

skills.name: distill-experience
skills.short_description: 与作者把真实经历提炼为候选方法
skills.core_judgment: 事实、解释与方法分开，明确确认只覆盖对应条件
skills.when_to_use: 作者想将自己的经历与判断变成可复用方法
skills.input_example: 一次MVP成功，怎样提炼成适用条件明确的经验？
skills.result_example: 候选方法卡、反例及最有区分力的校准问题。
skills.boundary: 已发生工程工作的学习用management-retro；这里还要形成方法。
skills.boundary_en: To learn from completed engineering work, use management-retro; this skill also turns the experience into a method.
skills.core_judgment_en: Keep facts, interpretations, and methods separate; explicit confirmation applies only to the conditions confirmed.

skills.name: person-deep-analysis
skills.short_description: 理解材料中的表达、诉求与互动
skills.core_judgment: 按材料形成有限解释，单一片段不能补成稳定人格
skills.when_to_use: 理解自述、聊天、个人介绍或虚构角色
skills.input_example: 对方一次晚回消息，可以推断什么？
skills.result_example: 可见事实、候选解释和影响判断的未知。
skills.boundary: 有具体付款、凭证或威胁风险用interaction-risk-analysis。
skills.boundary_en: For concrete payment, credential, or threat risks, use interaction-risk-analysis.
skills.core_judgment_en: Form bounded interpretations from the available material; one interaction cannot establish a stable personality.

skills.name: interaction-risk-analysis
skills.short_description: 拆解可疑要求、行为效果和核验缺口
skills.core_judgment: 行动保护不必等到证明恶意，效果和利益不能证明主观意图
skills.when_to_use: 有具体可疑要求、欺骗、胁迫或霸凌线索
skills.input_example: 提现每付一次费用又要加钱，该怎样理解？
skills.result_example: 先处理当前风险，再给事件依据与可独立核验的选择。
skills.boundary: 一般人物或互动解读用person-deep-analysis。
skills.boundary_en: For a general reading of a person or interaction, use person-deep-analysis.
skills.core_judgment_en: Protective action need not wait for proof of malice; impact and benefit do not prove intent.

skills.name: conflict-alignment
skills.short_description: 厘清目标、事实、取舍与决定权
skills.core_judgment: 同层资源权限死结停止重复说服，整理材料上升支持
skills.when_to_use: 协作各方对目标、事实或取舍有实质分歧
skills.input_example: 双方无权改变各自承诺，又争同一资源窗口。
skills.result_example: 找出卡点及适当的核验或上升决定请求。
skills.boundary: 怎样表达用conversation-preparation，是否答应用relationship-boundaries。二线在多个团队间取舍与授权用manager-of-managers。
skills.boundary_en: To draft how to say it, use conversation-preparation. To decide whether to agree, use relationship-boundaries. A second-line manager choosing across teams uses manager-of-managers.
skills.core_judgment_en: When a peer-level resource or authority deadlock persists, stop repeating persuasion and seek support with the evidence.

skills.name: conversation-preparation
skills.short_description: 准备澄清、反馈、请求与可兑现承诺
skills.core_judgment: 先澄清，再反馈，最后承诺；草稿和共识是不同状态
skills.when_to_use: 想准备一次反馈、请求、拒绝或澄清谈话
skills.input_example: 只写一句拒绝临时任务的短消息。
skills.result_example: 准确短稿或议程，不编对方动机及自己的承诺。
skills.boundary: 先判断能承担什么用relationship-boundaries。
skills.boundary_en: To decide what you can take on first, use relationship-boundaries.
skills.core_judgment_en: Clarify first, give feedback next, and make commitments last; a draft is not agreement.

skills.name: one-on-one
skills.short_description: 诊断目标、能力、资源与授权支持
skills.core_judgment: 先有共同验收标准；纯资源问题可保留成员负责，权限缺口负责人介入
skills.when_to_use: 上下级需要对齐目标、预期、支持或授权
skills.input_example: 成员说做不到，卡在资源还是权限？
skills.result_example: 明确缺口、谁提供支持与谁继续负责，未落实安排留待确认。
skills.boundary: 选指导、支持或授权方式用situational-leadership；通用谈话表达用conversation-preparation。刚进入新环境、需要先获取信息用new-context-onboarding。
skills.boundary_en: To choose direction, support, or delegation for a task, use situational-leadership. For general conversation wording, use conversation-preparation. When entering a new context and information comes first, use new-context-onboarding.
skills.core_judgment_en: Set shared acceptance criteria first; keep ownership with the teammate for resource gaps, and involve the manager for authority gaps.

skills.name: situational-leadership
skills.short_description: 按具体任务的能力、投入和授权边界，选择指导、教练、支持或放权
skills.core_judgment: 同一个人按任务分别判断；能力投入与组织权限分开，支持随证据调整
skills.when_to_use: 决定一项任务该给多少指导、教练、支持或授权，或任务状态变化
skills.input_example: 资深成员接陌生任务很积极，但判断不了回滚，能完全放权吗？
skills.result_example: 区分任务能力与意愿，给具体指导、成员责任与调整信号，权限缺口单独处理。
skills.boundary: 整理谈话与双方预期用one-on-one；本项选择管理支持方式，不给人格或整体绩效等级。二线管理多位负责人的资源与授权用manager-of-managers。
skills.boundary_en: To organize a conversation and both sides' expectations, use one-on-one. This skill chooses the management support for a task and does not assign a personality or overall performance grade. A second-line manager allocating resources and authority across leads uses manager-of-managers.
skills.core_judgment_en: Assess the same person by task; distinguish capability and motivation from organizational authority, and adjust support as evidence changes.

skills.name: relationship-boundaries
skills.short_description: 选择能答应、转介、分享或拒绝的范围
skills.core_judgment: 介绍渠道与能力背书分开，拒绝不要求补偿性帮助
skills.when_to_use: 面对求助、推荐、介绍、信息分享或承诺调整
skills.input_example: 朋友希望我推荐一个从没合作过的人。
skills.result_example: 给可靠帮助范围与可选回应，既有承诺不抹掉。
skills.boundary: 确定范围后，需要谈话草稿再用conversation-preparation。
skills.boundary_en: After the scope is clear, use conversation-preparation when a conversation draft is needed.
skills.core_judgment_en: Keep introductions separate from endorsements; declining a request does not require compensatory help.

skills.name: gift-planning
skills.short_description: 匹配关系、场合、需求与预算
skills.core_judgment: 先确认需求再设计惊喜，未知偏好不靠身份标签填补
skills.when_to_use: 选择通用、定制或体验礼物方向
skills.input_example: 预算500元、不知道气味喜好，怎样规划生日礼物？
skills.result_example: 有条件的方向与关键确认项，具体商品另行核验。
skills.boundary: 关系表达规划不自动购买、订票或联系别人。
skills.boundary_en: Planning how to express a relationship does not purchase, book, or contact anyone.
skills.core_judgment_en: Understand the recipient’s needs before planning a surprise; do not infer preferences from identity labels.

skills.name: problem-location
skills.short_description: 把表层症状推到可检验的底层约束
skills.core_judgment: 先让材料可被共同检查，再区分表层与底层；没有调查不宣布根因
skills.when_to_use: 方案正确却没解决问题，或讨论停在症状与互相指责
skills.input_example: 合作方投诉响应慢，老板让值班的人更快回复，这样对吗？
skills.result_example: 四格命题、有用的联系、可反驳的底层陈述与方案对准检查。
skills.boundary: 指标口径与实验用metric-decision，多方权限死结用conflict-alignment，已完成工作的复盘用management-retro。
skills.boundary_en: For metric definitions and experiments, use metric-decision. For a multi-party authority deadlock, use conflict-alignment. For a retrospective of completed work, use management-retro.
skills.core_judgment_en: Make evidence jointly inspectable, then distinguish symptoms from deeper causes; do not declare a root cause without investigation.

skills.name: project-diligence
skills.short_description: 区分画布自洽、路演说服与尽调验证
skills.core_judgment: 画布查自洽、路演是说服、尽调才独立验证；假设不能讲成事实
skills.when_to_use: 判断创业项目或新业务是否成立、该不该继续投入
skills.input_example: 九格画布都填满了，能拿去融资吗？
skills.result_example: 当前阶段必须回答的问题、供需缺口、核验清单与进入继续退出条件。
skills.boundary: 数字本身是否可信用metric-decision；法律与税务问题交专业人士。
skills.boundary_en: To judge whether a number itself is trustworthy, use metric-decision. Legal and tax questions go to a qualified professional.
skills.core_judgment_en: Use a canvas to check coherence, a pitch to persuade, and diligence to verify independently; keep assumptions distinct from facts.

skills.name: new-context-onboarding
skills.short_description: 画价值链地图，拆出缺信息、授权还是支持
skills.core_judgment: 信息不足不等于能力不足；先获取信息，再汇报，再要资源
skills.when_to_use: 刚进入陌生团队、业务或系统，或要带新人、写入门概览
skills.input_example: 入职两个月只有需求，想做增长证明自己，该怎么开始？
skills.result_example: 缺口判断、一页地图与空白、下一周要找的人及汇报顺序。
skills.boundary: 选具体任务的支持方式用situational-leadership，与主管对齐预期用one-on-one。
skills.boundary_en: To choose support for a specific task, use situational-leadership. To align expectations with a manager, use one-on-one.
skills.core_judgment_en: Limited information does not imply limited ability; learn the context before reporting or requesting resources.

skills.name: manager-of-managers
skills.short_description: 二线的取舍、授权、梯队与治理底线
skills.core_judgment: 决定、责任和代价要一起落地；安全合规公平不能用结果交换
skills.when_to_use: 多位一线负责人之间的资源取舍、授权升级、负责人来源与交接
skills.input_example: 我想直接给隔壁团队的工程师派活，因为这样最快。
skills.result_example: 是否二线问题、卡在哪一层、选项与代价、决定后留下的记录。
skills.boundary: 单个成员的任务支持用situational-leadership，面试证据用hiring-assessment；具体人事与法律处理交专业角色。
skills.boundary_en: For support on one person's task, use situational-leadership. For interview evidence, use hiring-assessment. Specific personnel and legal handling go to the appropriate specialist.
skills.core_judgment_en: Align decisions, responsibility, and consequences; do not trade away safety, compliance, or fairness for outcomes.

skills.name: hiring-assessment
skills.short_description: 定义缺口、设计追问并整理面试证据
skills.core_judgment: 反馈分事实、推断与偏好；潜力是开放假设，不是标签
skills.when_to_use: 用人方或面试官定义岗位缺口、追问项目、整理面试与定级证据
skills.input_example: 三位面试官分别写技术还行、文化不匹配、不够成熟，帮我汇总。
skills.result_example: 把感觉改写成具体事实与待补证据，列追问，不替组织作录用决定。
skills.boundary: 候选人检查自己的经历用experience-review；不以受保护特征为评估依据。
skills.boundary_en: A candidate checking their own experience uses experience-review. Protected characteristics are not evaluation criteria.
skills.core_judgment_en: Separate observed facts, inferences, and preferences; treat potential as an open hypothesis, not a label.
